name: Aunt Caroline
source:
LIKES: Teaching
DISLIKES: Her Father 

Myka's paternal aunt.

A no nonsense business woman and prominent professor at the university Myka attended.

Valuing exceptional achievement and focused on guiding her nephew into a prosperous business career. Whether he wants it or not.
